style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Item 2.05&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Costs Associated with Exit or Disposal Activities.</span></div><div style="margin-top:12pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">On May 1, 2026, Ingredion Incorporated (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) committed to a plan to cease operations at its Cabo, Brazil manufacturing facility (the &#8220;Cabo manufacturing facility&#8221;) as of June 30, 2026. The Company expects to sell the manufacturing facility and the underlying real property but has not entered into a contract of sale as of the date of this report.</span></div><div style="margin-top:12pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The Company expects to incur pre-tax non-recurring charges of approximately $43 million under the plan, of which approximately $36 million is expected to consist of impairment charges relating to fixed asset and inventory write-downs and approximately $7 million is expected to consist of cash expenditures for employee-related costs, severance payments, and other termination-related costs. The Company expects to incur the majority of these charges in the second quarter of 2026 and the remaining charges in subsequent fiscal periods through the first quarter of 2027. </span></div><div style="margin-top:12pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The foregoing estimates of the charges the Company expects to incur under the plan are subject to assumptions, and actual charges may differ from such estimates.</span></div><div id="i6052e325ba09474daab3ab2851c63dd9_102"></div><div
